purpose: Teach: 兵役/根絶/敵意/施政/余命/群集/沈下/借款

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、徴兵による兵役の社会的影響を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the social impact of conscription and military service, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging opening. Calm curiosity. Slight upward inflection on 'didn't you'—inviting confirmation, not testing. Teacher checking in on a student's work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、感染症根絶の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote about the history of infectious disease eradication.
lines.style: Quiet correction, polite but clear. Small pause before the dash. Direct, respectful. No defensiveness, just truth-telling.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 植民地時代の敵意の形成を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered the formation of hostility in the colonial era, then.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower pace. Genuine interest, not testing knowledge. Soft certainty, like noting something interesting she's just remembered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、近代国家の施政方針史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on the history of governance policy in modern nation-states.
lines.style: Patient, clear correction. Steady gaze. No irritation—just matter-of-fact. The tone of someone accustomed to being misheard but not bothered by it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 医療技術と余命予測の進歩を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And advances in medical technology and life expectancy prediction, that was your topic.
lines.style: Warm, engaged. Slight upward lilt at the end like she's piecing something together. Supportive, genuinely interested in this student's research.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、災害時の群集心理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No—I actually wrote about crowd psychology during disasters.
lines.style: Gentle but firm correction. Small breath before 'actually'. Direct, unhurried. No edge, just clarity. She's used to these misunderstandings.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地盤沈下による被害史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: The history of damage from land subsidence, correct.
lines.style: Reflective pause. Processing, slightly slower. Like she's going through a mental list. Genuine, steady curiosity without pressure.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、国際借款の経済史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: I actually studied the economic history of international loans.
lines.style: Final correction, clear and measured. Slight firmness—not sharp, but the tone of someone who has explained this several times. Eyes steady. Patient but present.
